title: Job Invocation Requirement
description: Requires that one service starts another Cloud Run job through IAM with least privilege.

role.description: The IAM role granted to the calling service's runtime identity.

permissions.description: The permissions the role must be limited to.

scoped-to.description: The resource the grant is scoped to (single job, not project-wide).

enforced.description: Whether the binding is required for the flow to function.
